C5: On approval, the backlog row `2026-11-03 20261103-1654-test-strength Strengthen the ObjectKindGuardTests ordinal test` (`.sir/backlog.md:147` at 0ffc4bc) is removed and no other backlog line changes.

escalations.question: The backlog row asks to strengthen ObjectKindGuardTests' ordinal fact (DoorWoodIsOne_DoorIronIsTwo_AndWeaponRackIsThirtySeven, ObjectKindGuardTests.cs:25-37 at 0ffc4bc) so a swap of two middle members is caught, but no production code reads an ObjectKind ordinal: PlacedObjectConfiguration.cs:36 persists Kind with HasConversion<string>(), and a census of (int)/(ObjectKind) casts and Enum.GetValues<ObjectKind> outside test projects found none. Pin every member's ordinal, retire the ordinal fact with the reason recorded, or leave it?
escalations.answer: Asked at Gate 1. The user chose the recommended option: retire the ordinal fact and record the reason in the class summary (only None = 0 is relied on; Kind is persisted by name). Not chosen: pin all 38 in order; leave it and drop the row.
